note: Each of the three transactions, including the 'victim', is a closed WETH→SWAG→CREAM/USDC→WETH arbitrage loop through the same contract 0x860bd. Each starts and ends in WETH with no SWAG left over, so no position is opened in the front leg and closed in the back leg; the senders also differ (0x147c, 0xedef, 0xcc51). The figures net the contract's front (+0.134766) and back (+0.020419) loop gains against the two senders' gas, which is only a loose 'actor' attribution.
